question: show all jobs for Zanzibar Serena Hotel this year
gold_sql: SELECT COALESCE(wo.work_number, wo.id) AS job, wo.status FROM work_orders wo JOIN customers c ON c.id=wo.customer_id WHERE c.name='ZANZIBAR SERENA HOTEL' AND YEAR(wo.created_at)=2026
agent_sql_scrubbed: SELECT work_number, create_date, title, description, status FROM work_orders WHERE customer_id = (SELECT id FROM customers WHERE name = ?) AND YEAR(created_at) = 2026
